verdict.rationale: Users run the whole stack on their own hardware. You flash the ESP32 yourself with flash.sh, and you build and sign the iPhone app yourself with a free Apple ID. The agent runs on the phone with no computer or vendor service required. The model can be any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including self-hosted vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp or Ollama, and prompts are editable files bundled at build time. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or redistribution terms in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted setup (the evidence is all repo README claims).
